text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. The main goal is to make code cleaner and easier to understand. When developers refactor, they reorganize and simplify their code, but the program still behaves exactly the same way. This is important because readable code is easier to maintain and fix. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which builds up when quick solutions are used instead of proper ones. By regularly refactoring, teams keep their projects healthy and save time in the future. Good refactoring is a careful, steady habit rather than a single big change.
